svg.text: Lane F — the smoke test: strictly sequential, and the only lane a human had to finish
Group 0.8. Fully parallel with lanes A–E: it shares no file with them.
build, tag and push the image
zero errors, live logs, capture, chain
O1 — the registry host that actually answers · O2 — the NET_RAW capability is honoured
O3 — the MTU probe was optional and not run · O4 — the AAOS listener check was unavailable
Hop 3 into the IVI node has indirect evidence only: the ADA node's own transmit and capture lines prove the datagram left the bridge for the IVI address, not that it arrived.
The image also had to be rebuilt single-platform for arm64 before any node could pull it — a multi-platform manifest left the nodes provisioning forever.
This is the one Phase 0 acceptance box closed by a live deployment rather than by a green CI run.
